== RELAY rule, stateless attenuating relay + teacher dispatch (FLIP two-rule; k=5, m=0) (5 non-NOP lines)
 0 ADD   T0 = ADD(SENSE, IN0_0)
 1 SHR   PAY0 = T0 >> 1
 2 MULQ  EMIT = MULQ(PAY0, PAY0)
 3 SHR   T1 = SENSE >> 7
 4 SETRULE S0 = SETRULE(T1, S0)

== RELAY rule, dedup relay (relay_flood semantics) + dispatch (k=11, m=1) (11 non-NOP lines)
 0 ADD   T0 = ADD(SENSE, IN0_0)
 1 GT    T2 = GT(T0, ZERO)
 2 GT    T3 = GT(ZERO, T0)
 3 SUB   PAY0 = SUB(T2, T3)
 4 SUB   T1 = SUB(PAY0, S1)
 5 MULQ  EMIT = MULQ(PAY0, T1)
 6 ADD   T2 = ADD(T2, T3)
 7 MULQ  T1 = MULQ(T1, T2)
 8 ADD   S1 = ADD(S1, T1)
 9 SHR   T1 = SENSE >> 7
10 SETRULE S0 = SETRULE(T1, S0)

== ACTUATOR rule v3 (FLIP; never emits; free under the economy) (29 non-NOP lines)
 0 GT    T0 = GT(IN0_0, ZERO)
 1 GT    T1 = GT(ZERO, IN0_0)
 2 SUB   T2 = SUB(T0, T1)
 3 ADD   T2 = ADD(T2, T2)
 4 ADD   T2 = ADD(T2, S2)
 5 GT    T0 = GT(T2, ZERO)
 6 GT    T1 = GT(ZERO, T2)
 7 SUB   S2 = SUB(T0, T1)
 8 GT    T0 = GT(SENSE, ZERO)
 9 GT    T1 = GT(ZERO, SENSE)
10 SUB   RPORT = SUB(T0, T1)
11 MULQ  T2 = MULQ(RPORT, S2)
12 ADD   T2 = ADD(T2, T2)
13 ADD   T2 = ADD(T2, S1)
14 GT    T0 = GT(T2, ZERO)
15 GT    T1 = GT(ZERO, T2)
16 SUB   T2 = SUB(T0, T1)
17 MULQ  T3 = MULQ(T2, T2)
18 SHR   T3 = T3 >> 2
19 MULQ  T0 = MULQ(SENSE, SENSE)
20 MAX   T3 = MAX(T3, T0)
21 CONST T0 = 100 << 0
22 GT    T0 = GT(T0, ENERGY)
23 SHR   T0 = T0 >> 2
24 MAX   T3 = MAX(T3, T0)
25 SHR   T3 = T3 >> 6
26 ADD   S1 = ADD(T2, T3)
27 SETRULE S0 = SETRULE(S1, S0)
28 MULQ  S0 = MULQ(S2, S1)
